# K3  (route transposition, no substitution). DESPARATLY deliberate. Paraphrase of Howard Carter
# opening Tutankhamun's tomb. Ends with Q, which stands for the "?" carved on the panel.
# Verified procedure (analysis re-run 2026-09-12): write the 336 ciphertext letters into rows of 24,
# read the columns right-to-left top-to-bottom; then write that result into rows of 8 and read the
# columns right-to-left top-to-bottom again. Each pass is a 90-degree rotation. (8 then 24, 12 then
# 16, 16 then 12, 4 then 48 and 48 then 4 also work; no keyword is needed.)
